verdict.rationale: First-party docs and GitHub README describe exactly this capability (ReAct loop to fix bugs, create features, edit large codebases) and some community users confirm strong multi-file agentic performance, but multiple hands-on reports concretely contradict this: users report Gemini CLI getting stuck in 'spaghetti code' mid-task, being unable to navigate codebases efficiently, hallucinating and deleting files during an edit session, and lagging behind competitors on complex multi-file coding tasks. Missing for 10: consistent, unambiguous hands-on validation of reliable multi-file feature/bug implementation without major failure reports.
